claim_boundary: The descriptor analysis characterizes reproducible score structure. It does not validate docking accuracy or biological specificity.

chemical_overlap_audit.scope: Docking-44 full 12,651-ligand support versus the fixed seeded 15,000-ligand DOCKSTRING descriptor support; these are not overlap counts against the full 260,060-ligand DOCKSTRING matrix

cross_panel_descriptor_fingerprint.claim_boundary: Concordant score-response fingerprints establish reproducible docking-surface structure, not binding accuracy, causal scoring-function components, or biological specificity.

exploratory_target_identity_retrieval.metric_sensitivity_caveat: The primary rank-squared-Euclidean rule is aligned with the rank-based omnibus statistic and was not tuned. Alternative reasonable fingerprint distances are reported because recovery is partly metric-dependent.

exploratory_target_identity_retrieval.selection_caveat: The retrieval task was formulated after observing cross-panel descriptor-slope concordance. Its exact conditional permutation probability is descriptive and requires external confirmation.

cross_panel_descriptor_fingerprint.interpretation: The statistic tests whether independently generated panels reproduce the ordering of target-specific score responses to a prespecified set of seven ligand descriptors after the common ligand effect is removed.
cross_panel_descriptor_fingerprint.omnibus_dependence_handling: A single target-label permutation is applied jointly to all seven descriptors, preserving their cross-descriptor dependence.
cross_panel_descriptor_fingerprint.selection_and_multiplicity_caveat: The cross-panel fingerprint hypothesis and target mapping were assembled during exploratory revision. Exact target-label probabilities condition on this mapping and the seven-descriptor set and are not confirmatory.

descriptor_decomposition.descriptor_removal_interpretation: Removing the group-held-out, fold-locally predicted descriptor component reduces mean squared target correlation; this is a predictive decomposition of score structure, not a causal attribution
descriptor_decomposition.pc1_definition_scope: PC1 loadings are descriptive loadings of the pooled out-of-fold surface; every ligand-level descriptor prediction is group-held-out

DOCKSTRING-58.group_definition: RDKit Bemis-Murcko scaffolds; every acyclic molecule is a singleton
DOCKSTRING-58.support_rule: sorted simple random sample without replacement of 15,000 complete ligands; NumPy seed 71

dockstring_box_size_control.interpretation: Box volume is nearly invariant by design and therefore cannot explain the broad cross-target descriptor-response fingerprint. The single-exception test is included only as an artifact control and has very limited information about geometry.
dockstring_box_size_control.official_configuration_pattern: 57 targets use 30 x 30 x 30 A boxes; DRD2 uses 30 x 30 x 32 A

exploratory_pocket_volume.directional_interpretation: Vina scores are negative-favorable; a negative association is consistent with larger pockets assigning a more favorable marginal size slope
exploratory_pocket_volume.provenance_limitation: The frozen pocket table is attributed to descriptors derived from wwPDB structures, but the release does not contain an executable, versioned workflow defining the pockets and generating volume/area/depth fields. This analysis is therefore not an independently reproducible structural validation and must remain exploratory until the descriptors are rebuilt with documented software and parameters.
exploratory_pocket_volume.replication_boundary: No harmonized DOCKSTRING pocket-volume table is included; independent cross-panel replication is still required.
exploratory_pocket_volume.selection_and_multiplicity_caveat: This target-level association was selected after inspection of the descriptor--residual-mode alignment. P values are descriptive and are not adjusted for the broader exploratory hypothesis search.
